sys_script_include.description: Returns true if the given user is a potential (or valid) technical user. "Potential" means that the user has any traits of a typical technical user, but does not fully comply with all requirements. E.g. the user has the "machine" identity type, or the first name starts with "Technical" or the first name starts with "technical.", etc.
sys_script_include.name: IsPotentialTechnicalUser
